correctness.rationale: Direct integration of the exponential steady profile gives a one-to-one inflow–total-count relation. For all h/L in (0,1), the logarithmic maturity-loss rate H is positive and strictly increasing because s/sinh(s) strictly decreases, yielding exactly one crossing and a nondegenerate maximum. The N→∞ asymptotic and Lambert midpoint algebra are explicit. CHECK.py reruns direct closures and representative parameters; computations supplement, rather than prove, the quantified theorem.

value.rationale: For exogenously supplied juveniles a regulator may track the stock above a maturity size rather than total count; their responses can oppose each other. The theorem resolves the number and exact location of adult-stock optima for every positive growth, crowding and maturation scale, shows a stark high-stocking decline, and gives a closed calibration example. This is more informative than qualitative overstocking and is not a claim of field applicability.
